scope: Review per-case identity, browser state, asynchronous processing, EG temporary token, and Cloudflare AI request isolation

baseline_defects.finding: On file-input change, old subject/scope/parcel/legal fields are not cleared using the full reset path; intakeResults only inserts a subject if existing subject text is empty, so old-case text may survive replacement.
Only subscribes to kt80:case-reset, not kt80:case-change; same-text A/B cases can allow old pending subject proposal to remain unless a full reset occurs.

controls_verified: Worker src sends new independent model input for author, subject-improve and scope-improve without conversation or previous_response_id; all requests use store:false.
EG access session keeps credential only in RAM, associates it to workflow generation and clears on case reset, change and procedure confirmation.
New V590 creates an independent caseCycleId on every new file and full reset, with UUID on secure browsers.
New V590 treats selecting a new dossier file as the same full-reset boundary as Clear All while preserving the chosen input File.
New V590 aborts old intake and invalidates results through generation counter.
New V571 clears subject proposal on both change/reset and rejects late AI reply associated with another caseCycleId.
A->B transfer tests cover subject, scope, parcels, legal notes, confirmations, dossier-derived drafts, same filenames, and delayed document extraction.
Mocked sequential Worker calls through the same runtime prove no cross-call facts are added to subject or scope inputs.
caveats: New V590/V571 is enabled only in an isolated preview, not retrofitted into the original V59.8 production/test HTML.
Tests include browser emulation and mocked Worker fetches, not a full visual browser session or a real remote OpenAI request.
Not every legacy V27 submodule has been exhaustively audited for persisted state or overlapping requests.
Technical per-case separation does not remove static legal priorities or example-derived assumptions hardcoded into common prompts or source files. Such biases require a separate source-first audit.
The case ID fallback without crypto.randomUUID is locally unique within the running page, not a guaranteed global UUID.
store:false does not by itself establish that external providers retain no logs or data for security/abuse monitoring.
next_action: Use isolated preview to visually test selecting A.zip then B.zip without pressing Clear All and confirm all stage panels, evidence and procedural state have reset. Only then consider a reviewed promotion of V590/V571 into live KT80.
